WITH pv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, r.calif, julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS dias_retraso
  FROM order_items oi JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN (SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS calif FROM order_reviews GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE v.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
rango AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 0 THEN 'a_tiempo'
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 3 THEN '1-3'
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 7 THEN '4-7'
    WHEN dias_retraso <= 14 THEN '8-14'
    ELSE '15+'
  END AS rango, COUNT(*) AS pedidos, AVG(calif) AS calif_promedio
  FROM pv GROUP BY dias_retraso
)
SELECT 
  rango, pedidos, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN calif <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / pedidos, 2) AS pct_calif_baja,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN calif <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id), 2) AS pct_calif_baja_atiempo
FROM rango
WHERE rango <> 'a_tiempo'
GROUP BY rango, pedidos, calif_promedio
HAVING pct_calif_baja > 2 * pct_calif

WITH vendedores AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos, AVG(r.review_score) AS calificacion, 
         ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_tarde
  FROM order_items oi JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = v.order_id
  JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
  WHERE v.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
),
top_ingresos AS (
  SELECT seller_id, ingresos, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ingresos DESC) AS rango_ingresos
  FROM vendedores
),
top_ingresos_25 AS (
  SELECT seller_id, ingresos
  FROM top_ingresos
  WHERE rango_ingresos <= 25
),
top_ingresos_25_calificacion AS (
  SELECT seller_id, ingresos
  FROM top_ingresos_25
  WHERE calificacion < 3.5 OR pct_tarde > 15
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cantidad_vendedores, SUM(ingresos) AS ingresos_total
FROM top_ingresos_25_calificacion

WITH pedidos_validos AS (
  SELECT order_id, customer_unique_id, customer_state, order_status, order_purchase_timestamp, order_estimated_delivery_date, order_delivered_customer_date
  FROM vw_pedidos_validos
),
reseñas asv (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(review_score) AS calif
  FROM order_reviews
  GROUP BY order_id
),
categorias AS (
  SELECT p.product_id, ptc.product_category_name_english AS categoria
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation ptc ON ptc.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  GROUP BY p.product_id, ptc.product_category_name_english
),
pedidos_categorias AS (
  SELECT order_id, categoria
  FROM categorias
  JOIN order_items ON order_items.product_id = categorias.product_id
  GROUP BY order_id, categoria
),
categorias_reseñas asv (
  SELECT categoria, AVG(calif) AS calif_promedio
  FROM categorias
  JOIN pedidos_categorias ON pedidos_categorias.order_id = categorias.order_id
  JOIN reseñas onv reseñas.order_id = pedidos_categorias.order_id
  GROUP BY categoria
),
categorias_reseñas_promedio AS (
  SELECT AVG(calif_promedio) AS calif_promedio_promedio
  FROM categorias_reseñas
),
categorias_retrasos AS (
  SELECT categoria, COUNT(*) AS pedidos, SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retrasos
  FROM pedidos_validos
  JOIN pedidos_categorias
